fit.lead: Choose your car and see the wheel diameter and axle it needs, then jump straight to the parts that fit.
fit.label: Your casting

anat.lead: A detailed 1:64 wheel is more than one piece of plastic. Hover each component to see how it is built.
anat.tyre_text: The tyre sits on the outside of the wheel and grips the track.
anat.lip_text: The lip and barrel give the wheel its depth and dish.
anat.face_text: The face carries the spoke design and the finish.
anat.disc_text: A separate rotor behind the spokes, so the wheel looks right from every angle.
anat.hub_text: The centre of the wheel, where it meets the axle.

ugc.heading: Built by you
ugc.sub: Real builds from the community. Tap the dots on a photo to buy the parts used.
ugc.cta_title: Tag @hpzdiecast or submit your build to be featured.

svc.heading: More than a parts shop
svc.sub: We also design decals, build cars to order and supply hobby shops.

acad.sub: Step-by-step guides from our workshop. Free, no fluff.
